content.short: World App is the premier self-custody wallet for the World Network, providing secure digital identity.
content.description: World App is a revolutionary decentralized application designed to provide users with a secure and intuitive gateway to the World Network ecosystem. As a self-custody solution, World App ensures that participants maintain full control over their private keys and digital assets while enjoying a seamless experience for identity verification and peer-to-peer payments. The platform features an integrated 'World ID' system that enables users to verify their humanness in a privacy-preserving manner, fostering a more accountable and inclusive digital environment. World App focuses on accessibility and global reaching, making it an essential component for navigating the next generation of decentralized identity and financial infrastructure.
content.meta: World App is the leading self-custody wallet for World Network, offering secure digital identity and seamless Web3 financial services.
